anchors.functionality: 8: Works, at most 2 majors (A2-01 leaf runs out of travel below a 6.1 setting; A1-03 pocket seats an undersized edge-on pair), each a small-part fix under 1 h
anchors.manufacturability: 8: 0 fastener fails, P1S fit, no supports, 104 mm bit listed in BOM; not 9 because the nip_cover 171 mm2 overhang is unexplained and 2 parts are in no assembly step
anchors.aesthetics: 9: every concrete item true (EB 1.0/0.6 within +/-0.5, CR {6,30}; no PCB/can exposed, wall rays 0.5x3; csk heads flush; colours encode the candy path); parting lines judged visually only

issues.problem: Below a 6.1 setting the leaf runs out of travel before a 7.0 candy on 0.5 tape passes: bare gap at full lift (-1.493) is 6.685 at the min stop, 6.98 at hood +1.0, 7.21 at +0.75, 7.44 at +0.5 (need 7.5), so 0.84 mm rigid squeeze at the min stop. The declared lift limit is also not the geometry: the stud is still 2.363 from the cover at -2.0 deg; the first contact is the thumbwheel on the nip cover at about -2.1 deg (gap ~7.27 at the min stop).
issues.evidence: review/cadcheck_review_lift.json distances rows 'bare gap at FULL leaf lift' (6.685/6.982/7.212/7.44); cadcheck warn '0.84 mm rigid squeeze on a 7.0 mm payload'; cad q sweep PRT_nip_wheel PRT_nip_cover PIV_nip_lift: 0.256 at -2.0, -5.1 mm3 at -2.5
issues.fix: Raise HOOD_GAP_MIN 5.3 -> 6.2 (stop at about hood +0.40 deg, NIP_SET 6.2..7.0), or keep 5.3 and give 2.8 deg of leaf lift (about 2.8 mm at the stud; open the nip cover 1.0 above the thumbwheel; relieve the hood/body bay to -3.4 deg effective). Set the PIV_nip_lift limit to the real first contact and add a PIV_hood-framed distances row: bare gap >= 7.5 at full lift at both stops.

issues.problem: The Ø14.4 pocket still seats an edge-on pair 1.5% under nominal. Symmetric pairs on the floor: 13x7 overlaps by only 0.607 mm3 each (rim vs chord), 12.8x6.8 by 0.016 mm3 (fits), 12.5x6.5 clears by 0.154 mm. The brief's candy is 'about 13 x 7', so this is a double-feed risk.
issues.evidence: cad q dist ZMM_{N,M,S}{a,b} PRT_feeder_disc on /tmp/rv2/probe/model_mm.blend (review/lentils.py); pocket rays R7.2 at (10.5,18.187), floor z 263.0
issues.fix: Declare MM_D/MM_T min/max from 20 calipered candies. Set POCKET_D 14.4 -> 13.9 (R6.95 blocks a 12.5x6.3 pair that needs R7.0, still clears a 13.5 flat candy by 0.2). Re-run the lentil probe at the min size (must overlap) and the max flat (must clear), and the pocket-over-outlet stack. If the window closes, lower BAFFLE_RAMP_TOP to disc+3.5 so a lone edge-on candy tips flat and a pair cannot pass.

issues.problem: The positive open stop works (blocked by the adapter at 52.5), but there are no detents at 0 or 52, so vibration can walk the gate. The open state is not in the interference sweep.
issues.evidence: review slide 'gate +X 56' blocked_by PRT_jar_adapter at 52.5 (review/cadcheck_review.json); BOM section 8 'gate detent bumps not modelled'
issues.fix: Add 0.4 mm detent bumps on a 1.2 x 8 cantilever cut into the blade, with dimples at 0 and 52; add a flexures row and a slide_out row at the open position.

issues.problem: New 1.12 wall in launcher_body at the widened bay; nip_cover has 171 mm2 of >45 deg overhang with supports=no (54.5 at the slot end, about 65 at the skirt top) and no reason given in the BOM.
issues.evidence: checks.parts: 'PRT_launcher_body: 10 wall samples < 1.6 mm (min 1.12)' at (10.4/25.6,-14.3,175.9); 'PRT_nip_cover: 171 mm2 of sloped overhang'; /tmp/rv2/probe/ovh.py regions
issues.fix: Step the bay hull 0.5 inboard above z 172 so the rim is 1.6; chamfer the cover's slot-end underside at 45 deg (or justify the 7.7 bridge); re-run parts.

issues.problem: Only CAB_phase_* has a lead_len. The bus (254/218/325), UART (214) and encoder (84) rows have none, and the hub U-loop for ±90 pan is not modelled although the brief requires the slack.
issues.evidence: checks.cables rows lead_len null; checks.json cable_leads = {CAB_phase_*: 80}; BOM section 8
issues.fix: Declare cable_leads for every purchased lead; model the U-loop in the R14 hub bore with >= 45 mm slack per cable (pi/2 x 14 x 2); re-run cables.

issues.problem: At tilt 0 the rim stands 1.1-1.4 proud of the slot end wall, but the guard land face sits 4.4 mm proud of the rim on the other side of the 7.5 slot. An R8 fingertip only reaches the rim's -u half. The free gap under the slot is 19.0 mm.
issues.evidence: cad q ray scan along 0,-0.316,0.949: rim 14.4, cover 15.5-15.8, PRT_launcher_body 10.0; ray 19.5,-8,124 0,0,-1 -> FST_gcap_3 at 19.0
issues.fix: Chamfer the guard land edge next to the slot 3 x 45, or raise TW_R 8.5 -> 9.5 so the rim stands >= 2 proud of both slot edges; record it as a distances ray row.

issues.problem: Config gaps: PRT_nip_stop_sleeve and FST_valve_* are in no assembly_order step; the step 10a label says M2 x 4 but the model and BOM use M2 x 8; there is no flexures row for the leaf (the review row passes at 2.2 deg); the fixed nip ray at y 37 slips past the hood lip at full lift (reads 14.18 where the real gap is about 8.3).
issues.evidence: checks.json assembly_order 6c/6e/12; not_checked 'flexures: no springs or snap arms declared'; review distances row at hood -0.558, lift -1.493 = 14.177
issues.fix: Add the sleeve to 6e and FST_valve_* to 12; correct the 10a label; add the leaf flexures row; frame the nip rays in PIV_hood.

issues.problem: At gap 5.3 and the +46 hard stop the flattest slide is 32.8 against a 28 stall (4.8 < 5 deg rule); at tilt 45 it is 33.8.
issues.evidence: checks.drop warn 'v2-A1-01 drop at the min-gap stop ... tilt=46: 32.8 deg'; review drop row tilt 45 = 33.8
issues.fix: Steepen the chute entry wall by 1 deg, or rely on the firmware clamp at 45 and note it; it goes away if A2-01 raises the min gap (gap 7.0 gives 33.5 at 46).
